name: position-picker
title: Position picker
description: A 3 by 3 grid to pick where something sits, such as an image anchor, a watermark corner or the position of a toast.
docs: value and onValueChange speak one of top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center and bottom-right. The nine places sit in a thin frame that reads as a small version of the surface, each dot toward its own edge or corner; the chosen place is a filled dot and the others are hollow. It is a radio group in two dimensions: the arrow keys move along the row and down the column, going round the edge, Home and End jump to the first and last place, and places that cannot be chosen are passed over. positions limits the choice to a subset (CORNERS, exported from position-picker/positions, is the four corners); the others are drawn as faint dots and cannot be reached. The group is named with the choice in words (Watermark position: Top right), label names what is being placed, and the choice is also shown under the frame unless showValue is false. size is sm, default or lg, name adds a hidden input with the place, and disabled turns the picker off. movePosition, positionLabel, POSITIONS and CORNERS are plain helpers in position-picker/positions.
